name: Poison Bloom
description: Injects venom into a target within %cast_range% tiles, applying %initial_poison% stacks of poison that grow instead of fading for %duration% turns.
details: Each of this unit's attacks on the victim adds another %duration_increase% turn to the bloom.
When the bloom ends it bursts, poisoning every enemy within %infect_radius% tile.
It spreads whether the host dies or the venom simply runs its course - but cleansing the bloom early prevents the burst entirely.
